# Flame Analytics

> Flame Analytics is a privacy-first AI video analytics platform for physical spaces. It transforms existing CCTV cameras into business intelligence tools — measuring foot traffic, customer journeys, conversion rates, and occupancy without biometrics. Fully GDPR and EU AI Act compliant. Trusted by IKEA, Decathlon, Repsol, Merlin Properties, CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield, and thousands of users across 7 countries.

## Core Products

- [Hypersensor — AI Video Analytics](https://flameanalytics.com/en/hypersensor/): Advanced AI that turns any IP camera (RTSP/ONVIF) into a smart analytics sensor. Silhouette-based detection, 95%+ accuracy, automatic staff exclusion, cross-camera reconnection. Zero biometrics, edge processing — video never leaves the premises.
- [People Counting](https://flameanalytics.com/en/people-counting/): Accurate footfall measurement across entrances, floors, and zones. External traffic, vehicle counting, and real-time occupancy. No dedicated sensors needed — works on existing CCTV.
- [Customer Journey](https://flameanalytics.com/en/customer-journey/): Cross-camera visitor path tracking, zone heatmaps, dwell time analysis, and behavioral segmentation — all without biometric identification.
- [Conversion Analytics](https://flameanalytics.com/en/conversion-analytics/): Measure visitor-to-buyer ratio, identify drop-off points, and optimize store performance with real-time conversion data.
- [Traffic Insights](https://flameanalytics.com/en/traffic-insights/): Real-time dashboards for pedestrian traffic patterns, peak hours, comparative benchmarks, and trend analysis across locations.
- [Queue Analytics](https://flameanalytics.com/en/queue-analytic/): Monitor queue length and wait times in real time. Trigger staff alerts, optimize checkout allocation, and reduce abandonment.
- [Occupancy Management](https://flameanalytics.com/en/occupancy-management/): Live capacity monitoring with configurable thresholds, automatic alerts, and compliance with safety regulations.
- [Connect — Guest WiFi Marketing](https://flameanalytics.com/en/connect/): Captive portal WiFi analytics. Collect visitor contact data and run personalized marketing campaigns based on location, demographics, and visit behavior.
- [Corporate WiFi Access](https://flameanalytics.com/en/corporate-wifi-access/): Secure network analytics for enterprise environments.
- [Restroom Management](https://flameanalytics.com/en/restroom-management/): Smart facility monitoring for cleaning schedules, usage patterns, and resource optimization.

## Industries

- [Retail Stores](https://flameanalytics.com/en/solution-for-retail-sector/): Optimize layouts, measure campaign ROI, benchmark locations, improve staff scheduling. Clients: IKEA, Decathlon, Pompeii, Havaianas, Alain Afflelou, Cash Converters.
- [Shopping Malls](https://flameanalytics.com/en/solution-for-shopping-malls/): Tenant performance analytics, common area optimization, loyalty programs, benchmarking across 50+ European malls. Clients: Merlin Properties, CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield, Westfield, Intu Xanadú, CC Plaza Éboli.
- [Hospitality](https://flameanalytics.com/en/hospitality/): Guest flow analytics, event capacity management, venue optimization. Clients: B&B Hotels, Hotels VIVA, Ilunion Hotels.
- [Public Venues](https://flameanalytics.com/en/public-venues/): Museums, stadiums, event spaces — visitor flow, exhibition performance, capacity planning. Client: CaixaForum.
- **Gas Stations**: High-volume visitor analytics and WiFi engagement. Client: Repsol (1,000+ stations across Spain).

## Key Differentiators

- **Zero biometrics**: AI analytics without facial recognition — privacy by design, GDPR and EU AI Act compliant
- **No new hardware**: Works with any existing IP camera (Hikvision, Dahua, Axis, Bosch, Hanwha — any RTSP/ONVIF)
- **Edge processing**: Video processed locally, never sent to the cloud. Only structured data (metrics, alerts) reaches the dashboard
- **All-in-one platform**: Only solution integrating people counting + customer journey + heatmaps + conversion + WiFi marketing
- **Proprietary benchmarks**: Database from 50+ European shopping malls for industry-level comparison
- **Proven at scale**: From single stores to 1,000+ locations
